name: Wesel (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Wesel (three white weasels around a white shield on red).
history: The arms are borne in their present form since a change of the city charter in 1984; the city flies the arms on a red and white flag.

features.role: Wesel arms — three weasels on red
